What we do

Plumbing & heating services across Derbyshire

One trusted engineer for everything from a dripping tap to a full boiler and cylinder installation.

Boiler Installations

New A-rated boilers fitted neatly, with manufacturer-backed warranties.

Boiler Servicing & Repairs

Annual servicing and fast fault-finding to keep your heating running.

General Plumbing

Taps, leaks, pipework, toilets and everything in between — no job too small.

Bathroom Installations

Full bathroom refits, from supply-only fits to complete design and install.

Unvented Cylinders

Central Heating & Radiators

Radiator upgrades, power flushing and full central heating systems.

Leak Detection & Repair

Emergency Call Outs

The transformation

Before & after

Watch two recent projects go from tired and dated to clean, modern installs — real jobs, real results.

Before → After
Combi Boiler Conversion

Old cylinder out, modern combi in

This airing cupboard was lost to a tired hot-water cylinder and storage tank. We stripped the lot out and fitted a modern combi boiler with neat, clipped copper pipework, a magnetic system filter and a full system flush — instant hot water, lower running costs and a cupboard back in use.

Derby
Before → After
Bathroom & Shower Refit

From dated cubicle to walk-in style

Out went the cramped quadrant enclosure; in came a sleek walk-in shower with a matt-black frame, low-profile tray and easy-clean wall panels — no grout to scrub, no leaks to chase, just a bathroom that feels brand new every morning.

Meet the owner

A local engineer who takes pride in every job

Plumbing Derbyshire is owner-run, which means the person who quotes your job is the same person who turns up and does the work. No subcontractors, no passing the buck — just one accountable, qualified engineer.

With over a decade in the trade across Derbyshire, the business has been built almost entirely on word of mouth. Whether it's a full boiler installation or a leaking tap, every job gets the same care and the same standard of finish.
